description: Generated from schemas/commands/catalog.json. The MCP server (stdio) offers exactly these tools (ADR-0009). $refs point into the top-level $defs.

baseline.title: Baseline file
baseline.description: A baseline is a YAML file with name, date, the commit of every repository involved and ID plus version of every element in the selection (D-039, SR-050). LogReq writes the file; a person commits it with Git (D-036, SR-050 AK4). No reason or approval field (D-006, SR-050 AK3). The metamodel of the baseline is given by the commit of the metamodel repository (D-021).

selection.description: How the elements were selected, for information. The element list is authoritative.

elements.description: Sorted by id; one flow mapping per line.

common.title: Shared definitions
common.description: Building blocks used by all LogReq file formats and commands. See docs/adr/0004 and 0005.

uuid.description: Element ID: random UUID version 4, lower case, never changes (D-017, SR-002).

shortId.description: Display ID: type prefix, dash, the trailing hex characters of the UUID with dashes removed, at least 6, more until unique in the workspace (D-017, SR-002 AK3). The file name uses 12 (D-056).

elementRef.description: A reference to an element as given by a person or an external tool: UUID or short ID (SR-060).

version.description: Fassung: normal-form version, colon, first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 over the canonical content (D-013, D-027, ADR-0005). Example: n1:9f86d081884c7d65.

key.description: Fixed metamodel key of a type, property, relation kind or status value. Readable English, lower case, dashes (D-043, SR-010 AK2).

relationTarget.description: Target of a relation as stored in the source file (D-013, D-058, SR-005, SR-021). Within the same repository: `id`, `version`, `title`. Across repositories: `id`, `version`, `repository` (workspace name of the target's repository), never title or text (D-058). Written as one flow mapping per line (SR-102, ADR-0004).

repository.description: Workspace name of the target's repository; required across repositories (D-058), absent within one.

commit.description: Full Git object ID (SHA-1 or SHA-256).

relativePath.description: Path relative to the repository or file it appears in, forward slashes, no `..` segments.

problem.description: A finding or hint. Commands return problems as data so every access shows the same result (SR-080).

hintId.description: Stable ID of a confirmable hint (D-042).

problemCode.description: Stable codes. New codes are added here first, in the PR that needs them.

error.description: Error of a command call. Same codes over CLI (stderr, exit code), API (HTTP body) and MCP (tool error).

incomplete.description: True when a result is incomplete because targets are in repositories that are not available locally (SR-006 AK2, SR-036 AK3).

selection.description: Which elements a command works on: a saved filter, an inline filter, a package, a baseline or explicit IDs, optionally seen through a variant view (SR-036 AK1, SR-043, SR-061 AK2).

baseline.description: Path or name of a baseline file.

view.description: `core`, a variant ID, or absent for all elements (SR-043).

verificationStatus.description: SR-031, SR-034. `indirect` = indirectly verified via children.

data-export.title: Data of a state (Stand) as JSON
data-export.description: Output of `data.export` and the file written by `data.store` (SR-061, SR-062) for external evaluation tools such as Grafana or DuckDB (D-008). Also defines the element and relation shapes all commands return.

text.description: Markdown body. Left out by list commands unless asked for.

versionDate.description: Date of the version from Git; null when not committed yet (D-013: shown instead of the hash).

readOnly.description: Unknown type, invalid metamodel or read-only repository (SR-011 AK3, SR-016 AK3, SR-018 AK2).

properties.description: All other properties by key, unknown ones included.

verification.description: Verification status per view: core and each variant the element is valid for (SR-047 AK3).

title.description: Only when the other end is available locally (SR-005 AK3, SR-006 AK1).

element.title: Element file frontmatter
element.description: YAML frontmatter of an element file (D-015, D-056). The Markdown text follows the closing `---`. Only `id`, `type` and `status` are structural; every other key is a property or relation kind key from the metamodel (D-043). Keys the metamodel does not know are kept unchanged and reported as hints (D-012, SR-016). See docs/adr/0004-element-file-format.md. File name: type prefix, dash, last 12 hex characters of the UUID, never changed (D-056). Value kinds are checked against the metamodel, not by this schema, so any value of an unknown key is kept (SR-016); `$defs/value` describes the values LogReq writes.

status.description: Status key from the metamodel. Only ever set by a person (D-030, SR-017).

normal-form.description: Reserved. Never written; the normal-form version is part of every stored version string (D-027).

value.description: Property value (text, number, date as YYYY-MM-DD, choice key, list) or relation targets. Which one is expected comes from the metamodel; a mismatch is a hint, not a parse error (SR-012 AK3).

evidence-record.title: Evidence record (Datensatz), Markdown frontmatter
evidence-record.description: Open format for a verification or validation record (D-007, D-026, SR-028). A manual record is a Markdown file with this frontmatter; the text below may describe the check. Automatic test results stay JUnit XML; the same fields are JUnit properties, see docs/adr/0012-evidence-records.md. The evidence itself (Beleg) stays where it is; `evidence` only points to it. Records written by LogReq (SR-030) and by anyone else count the same.

kind.description: Nachweis or Validierung (D-007). Validation counts only for the validation status (SR-030 AK3).

element.description: Verification: a requirement. Validation: a need or a requirement (D-012).

variant.description: Variant the record holds for. Absent: the core (D-026, SR-047 AK2).

item.description: Prüfling: the concrete build or sample that was checked. Required for verification, optional for validation (D-007).

evidence.description: Where the Beleg is: relative path, file URL or any URI. LogReq does not open or manage it.

test-case.description: Optional test case name or ID (D-026, SR-033).

filter.title: Saved filter file
filter.description: A named filter saved as YAML in the repository (D-056, SR-070). The same condition language is the `where` of every command that takes a selection, so a saved filter gives the same elements in app, CLI, API and MCP (SR-070 AK3).

name.description: Unique in the workspace; used to call the filter by name.

condition.description: Combinable condition (SR-069). Exactly one operator per object.

subtypes.description: Include subtypes of the type. Absent means true (no `default` keyword: defaults inside `oneOf` are not applied).

source.description: Value of the property with meaning `source` of imported elements (SR-057 AK2, D-059).

relationCondition.description: Condition on relations, e.g. without child: {relation: {meaning: derivation, direction: down}, exists: false} (SR-069 AK3). Evidence is a relation direction too.

direction.description: `up` = outgoing (to parents), `down` = incoming (from children), `evidence` = records pointing at the element.

to.description: Condition the other end must meet.

sortKey.description: Sort by a property, the short ID, or the derivation hierarchy (SR-075). Nothing about order is ever stored in element files.

metamodel.title: Metamodel file
metamodel.description: One YAML file of the metamodel (D-021, D-056, SR-011). A metamodel is all *.yaml files in the metamodel folder named in the workspace file; their lists are merged, and every key must be unique across all files. Keys never change; names may (D-043, SR-015). Built-in meanings (D-012) are attached with `meaning`. A type or property meaning is assigned to at most one key (SR-013, SR-014 AK3); several relation kinds may share a relation meaning, e.g. Refines and Derives from are both `derivation` (D-012). A type inherits the meaning of the type it extends unless it sets its own.

name.description: Display name. English in the standard model (D-019).

prefix.description: Prefix of the short ID, e.g. SR (D-017).

extends.description: Parent type; its properties are inherited (SR-012 AK2).

abstract.description: No elements of this type can be created; only for inheritance.

meaning.description: Built-in meaning of the type (D-012): `requirement` (target of verification), `need` (may be validated), `variant` (D-020), `package` (D-040).

properties.description: Property keys this type has, in addition to inherited ones.

required.description: Mandatory property keys (Pflichtfelder). Empty values are allowed but give a hint (SR-064).

content.description: Part of the content and therefore of the version (D-013). Title and status are never content.

meaning.description: Built-in meaning (D-012, D-059): `title`; `validity` (list of variants, D-020); `packages` (D-040); `emergent` (emergent behaviour, N-010); `verification-method`; `statement` (Stellungnahme for ReqIF, SR-058); `source`, `source-identifier`, `import-date`, `delivery` (origin of imported elements, written only by ReqIF import, SR-057).

relationKind.description: Relation kind (Beziehungsart). Stored under its key in the source file. `source-types`/`target-types` restrict where it may be set (SR-012 AK4, SR-067).

inverse-name.description: Name shown at the target, e.g. Derived by.

meaning.description: Built-in meaning (D-012, D-059). `derivation`: source is child, target is parent (chain, coverage, indirect verification). `replacement`: source replaces target, either for the variants in the source's validity (D-020) or, when the target has an invalid status, as its successor (D-045, SR-072). `exclusion`: source variant excludes target core requirement, written in the variant file (SR-042, D-059). Without meaning a relation has no traceability semantics.

invalid.description: Elements with this status do not count for coverage, verification degree and indirect verification, but stay visible in chains (D-044).

initial.description: Status of new elements. Exactly one status is initial.

reqif-mapping.title: ReqIF mapping file
reqif-mapping.description: Mapping of the types and attributes of one ReqIF source to the own metamodel, saved as YAML in the repository and reused for every later import from and export to that source (N-045, D-022, SR-054). The own metamodel is never changed by it (SR-054 AK3). Also holds saved export profiles (SR-059 AK3).

name.description: Name of the source as written to the property with meaning `source` (SR-057, D-059).

tool-id.description: REQ-IF-TOOL-ID seen in deliveries, for recognising the source.

target.description: Folder where imported elements are written.

source.description: LONG-NAME or IDENTIFIER of the SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE.

source-type.description: Restricts the entry to one SPEC-OBJECT-TYPE.

source.description: LONG-NAME or IDENTIFIER of the ATTRIBUTE-DEFINITION.
LONG-NAME or IDENTIFIER of the SPEC-RELATION-TYPE.

statement.description: Where the statement (Stellungnahme) goes when exporting back to the source (SR-058).

property.description: Own property that holds the statement.

workspace.title: Workspace file
workspace.description: `logreq-workspace.yaml` in the root of the main repository (D-041, SR-004). Names the repositories that belong together. Everyone has locally only those they may access; missing ones are shown as not available (N-041, SR-004 AK3). A single-repository workspace lists only itself (SR-004 AK2).

repositories.description: The first entry with `main: true` is the repository that holds this file. Names are unique.

metamodel.description: Where the metamodel lies: a folder in one of the repositories, the main one or its own (D-021, SR-011, SR-018).

evidence.description: Folders with evidence records (Markdown) and JUnit XML files (SR-028 AK1). They may be in repositories of other tools.

baselines.description: Where new baseline files are written. Default: folder `baselines` in the main repository.

filters.description: Where saved filters are written (SR-070). Default: folder `filters` in the main repository.

mappings.description: Where ReqIF mapping files are written (SR-054). Default: folder `reqif` in the main repository.

ignore.description: Glob patterns (relative to each repository) that are never read as elements. `.git` and `node_modules` are always ignored.

url.description: Address of the repository on the Git server. Informational: LogReq never clones or fetches (D-036).

path.description: Expected local location relative to the main repository. Default `../<name>`; `.` for the main repository. A person can override it in the untracked file `.logreq/local.yaml`.

tools.name: workspace_init
tools.description: Create a workspace with the standard model in an empty folder.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.

tools.name: workspace_status
tools.description: Repositories of the workspace, which are available, where the metamodel comes from, read-only state.

tools.name: workspace_check
tools.description: Check the whole workspace against the metamodel: files, required and unknown properties, missing targets, cycles, duplicate IDs, outdated relations. CLI exits 1 on findings.

changedSince.description: Git revision; only files changed since then and their targets (SR-025 AK4).

tools.name: metamodel_get
tools.description: The effective metamodel: types with inherited properties, properties, relation kinds, statuses, meanings.

meanings.description: Built-in meaning -> assigned key, null if unassigned (SR-013 AK3).

tools.name: element_create
tools.description: Create an element with a new random UUID. Only title, text and required properties are needed; empty required properties give a hint (SR-064). New elements always get the initial status of the metamodel (SR-017).

folder.description: Folder relative to the repository; default from the type.

tools.name: element_get
tools.description: One element with text, properties, relations, version and its date, hints, and which variants replace or exclude it.

tools.name: element_resolve
tools.description: Resolve a reference from another tool (UUID or short ID, optional version) and tell whether the version is current.

current.description: null when no version was given.

tools.name: element_list
tools.description: Elements of a selection, sorted; optionally as derivation tree.

tools.name: element_update
tools.description: Change title, text or properties of one element. Unknown properties are kept; status changes only via element.setStatus.

tools.name: element_setStatus
tools.description: Set the status of elements on explicit request of the caller. The only command besides element.supersede that changes a status; no command changes a status on its own (D-030, SR-017).

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.

tools.name: element_supersede
tools.description: Supersede an element: set an invalid status and optionally let a successor replace it (relation with meaning replacement, written into the successor's file). There is no delete (D-045).

relation.description: Relation kind with meaning replacement to write from the successor; needed only when more than one fits the types.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.

tools.name: element_bulkUpdate
tools.description: Set, add to or remove a property for all elements of a selection. Without `confirm` only previews.

tools.name: element_addAttachment
tools.description: Copy an image next to the element file and return the Markdown to insert; the image counts to the version (SR-065 AK2).

tools.name: relation_options
tools.description: Relation kinds and target types the metamodel allows for an element (SR-067).

tools.name: relation_add
tools.description: Add a relation; stores target UUID and current version, plus the title only within the same repository.

tools.name: relation_remove
tools.description: Remove a relation from the source file.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.

tools.name: trace_chain
tools.description: Chain up to the top parents and down to evidence, with depth, gaps and cycles.

tools.name: trace_related
tools.description: All children of a set of parents, or all parents of a set of requirements, each once, optionally up to a depth.

tools.name: trace_affected
tools.description: Elements affected by a change of one element, with path and distance.

tools.name: hint_list
tools.description: Open hints of the workspace, filterable by kind, type, package or variant.

tools.name: hint_confirm
tools.description: Confirm hints: writes the current target version into the relation and nothing else (D-042).

tools.name: element_search
tools.description: Full-text search over title, text, properties and IDs, typo tolerant, within a view or filter.

tools.name: filter_list
tools.description: Saved filters of the workspace.

tools.name: filter_save
tools.description: Save a named filter as YAML in the repository.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.

tools.name: evidence_list
tools.description: Evidence records of an element with version, item, date, result, evidence location and baselines that contain the version.

tools.name: evidence_record
tools.description: Write a manual verification or validation record; ID and current version are filled in.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.

tools.name: evidence_enrichJunit
tools.description: Add UUID, version, item and date to every test case of a JUnit XML file that names a short ID. CLI exits 1 on unknown IDs.

tools.name: evidence_status
tools.description: Verification and validation status of a selection per view, including indirect verification and missing children.

tools.name: evidence_coverage
tools.description: Coverage of a selection per level: how many have children, how many have evidence; with the element lists.

tools.name: evidence_degree
tools.description: Verification degree of a selection: share verified and count per status.

tools.name: data_export
tools.description: Data of the current state as JSON for external evaluation.

tools.name: data_store
tools.description: Write the data of the current state to a folder, file name contains the commit.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.

tools.name: variant_diff
tools.description: What a variant adds, replaces and excludes compared to the core.

tools.name: variant_exclude
tools.description: Exclude core requirements for a variant; written into the variant file only.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.

tools.name: baseline_create
tools.description: Write a baseline file for a selection. Refused while selected elements have uncommitted changes. Never commits.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.

tools.name: baseline_list
tools.description: Baseline files of the workspace.

tools.name: baseline_get
tools.description: Elements of a baseline with their version then, marked changed, added or superseded since; optional evidence status per version.

tools.name: baseline_compare
tools.description: The Git command and commits that show the difference of an element since a baseline (SR-051 AK3). Read only.

tools.name: reqif_analyze
tools.description: Read a ReqIF file: types and attributes without mapping, and for a repeated delivery the new, changed and dropped requirements. Writes nothing.

tools.name: reqif_import
tools.description: Import a ReqIF 1.2 file with a mapping; updates existing elements by IDENTIFIER, records origin, reports losses.

tools.name: reqif_saveMapping
tools.description: Save or change the mapping of a source to the own metamodel.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.

tools.name: reqif_export
tools.description: Export a selection or a saved export profile as ReqIF 1.2; IDENTIFIER is the UUID, or the source IDENTIFIER for statements.
